Row.Text: "The sea calmed and the whirlwind and flood stopped.[NEWLINE]Utnapishtim opened a window and felt fresh air on his face.[NEWLINE]He looked for coastlines at the horizon and saw a region of land.[NEWLINE]The boat lodged firmly on mount Nimush which held the boat for several days, allowing no swaying.[NEWLINE]He released a raven which was able to eat and scratch, and did not circle back to the boat.[NEWLINE]He then sent his livestock out in various directions."

"On the contrary. Every Bison dollar will be worth[NEWLINE] five British pounds. For that is the exchange rate[NEWLINE] that the bank of England will implement after[NEWLINE] I kidnap their queen."[NEWLINE]-M. Bison
"We are the authors of our own destiny;[NEWLINE]and being the authors, we are ultimately, perhaps frighteningly,[NEWLINE]free."[NEWLINE]-Shantideva
“大海平静了，旋风和洪水也停止了。[NEWLINE]乌特纳皮什蒂姆打开窗户，感到新鲜的空气扑面而来。[NEWLINE]他在地平线上寻找海岸线，看到了一片陆地。[NEWLINE]船牢牢地卡在尼穆什山上，尼穆什山将船固定了好几天，没有晃动。[NEWLINE]他放出了一只能吃能抓的乌鸦，但没有绕回船上。[NEWLINE]然后他把他的牲畜送到各个方向。”
“恰恰相反。每一块野牛币都值得[NEWLINE]五英镑。因为这就是汇率[NEWLINE]英格兰银行将在之后实施[NEWLINE]我绑架了他们的女王。”[NEWLINE]-M。野牛
“我们是自己命运的创造者；[NEWLINE]作为作者，我们最终，也许是令人恐惧的，[NEWLINE]自由的。”[NEWLINE]-寂天菩萨
